scope: mass_publicity_facts binds the Art. 21-bis mass-publicity predicates from the act's stated ground, stated period and posting records, counts the stated display days with the first day included and a record's inclusive end date through its end, and returns the notice day (the stated days counted from publication, that day excluded) only when A gives effectiveness; notice_instant returns the earliest instant among the notice branches A finds true, never an unknown branch's; noncommencement_facts computes no deadline without one; a stated count reads its digits, a bracketed word after them ignored; listing_facts binds L.R. 14/2007 Art. 5 status from a tree's own entry dates; trunk_diameter_facts compares a recorded diameter with B's Art. 2(1)(a) floor, whose outcomes the Art. 8(7bis), DDS 4/2022 and DDS 45/2023 characteristics conjuncts bind; eight reference-outcome pairs; the stated-period clock is a calendar duration. Binding takes effect only on merge.
